name: rsdp-poker-live

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rsdp/server" "npm run dev -w @rsdp/web"
scripts.test: npm test -w @rsdp/engine && npm test -w @rsdp/tournament && npm test -w @rsdp/server && npm test -w @rsdp/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/tournament && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
